scope: Atomic per-issuer D1 rate limit for the internal seller entitlement delivery API
implemented: Migration 0054 and Drizzle schema add one bounded counter row per issuer; the SQL upsert atomically starts/resets a minute window and increments request count.
Authenticated POST, GET and PATCH delivery calls share a fixed 120 requests/minute limit per issuer.
Over-limit calls return 429 with Retry-After; seller counters are isolated and a later minute resets the counter.
The limit is applied after seller authentication and idempotency-key validation, before any claim package is read or written.

focusedTests.rateLimitCase: atomic boundary, Retry-After, per-seller isolation, next-minute reset
